# 2. Analysis
## 2.1 Phylum level relative abundance
```{r}
path <- paste0("qiime/combined/6_Taxonomy_GTDB/feature_table.tsv")
relab<- read.table(path , header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
colnames(relab) <- format_sample_ids(colnames(relab))

firmicutes <- c("Firmicutes","Firmicutes_A","Firmicutes_B","Firmicutes_C" )
relab_phy <- relab %>% mutate(phylum = gsub(".*p__","",taxon),
                              phylum = gsub(";c__.*", "", phylum),
                              phylum = ifelse(phylum %in% firmicutes, "Firmicutes", phylum)) %>% 
             filter(phylum != "") %>% 
             select(-taxon) %>% group_by(phylum) %>% summarise_all(sum) %>% ungroup() %>% 
             column_to_rownames("phylum") %>%  mutate_all(~ . / sum(.)) %>% 
             t() %>% as.data.frame()

relab_phy_mean <- apply(relab_phy, 2, mean)
non_rare_phyla <- relab_phy_mean[relab_phy_mean > 0.01] %>% names() %>% sort()
```

```{r}
ggdata <- relab_phy %>% rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
          tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -sample_id, names_to = "taxon", values_to = "ra") %>% 
          mutate(taxon = ifelse(taxon %in% non_rare_phyla, taxon, "Other")) %>%
          group_by(sample_id, taxon) %>% summarise(ra = sum(ra)) %>% ungroup() %>%
          inner_join(mdata_all,by = "sample_id") %>% 
          group_by(patient_id ,phenotype, phenotype_binary, taxon )  %>% summarise(ra = mean(ra)) %>% ungroup() %>% mutate(phenotype = factor(phenotype, levels = label_order))

tmp_palette <- colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9,name = 'RdYlGn'))(length(non_rare_phyla))
names(tmp_palette) <- non_rare_phyla
tmp_palette["Other"] <- "grey"

ggdata <- ggdata %>% mutate(taxon = factor(taxon, levels = c(non_rare_phyla, "Other")))
```

```{r}
calculate_phyla_ratio <- function(df,  num, denom){
  phyla_ratio <- df %>% filter(taxon %in% c(num, denom)) %>% 
                 mutate(phyla_group = ifelse(taxon %in% num, "numerator", "denominator")) %>% 
                 group_by(patient_id,phenotype_binary,phenotype, phyla_group) %>% summarise(ra = sum(ra)) %>% ungroup() %>%
                 tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = phyla_group, values_from = ra) %>% 
                 mutate(ratio = numerator/denominator)
  return (phyla_ratio)
}
```


```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=4, fig.align='center'}
num <- c("Firmicutes")
denom <- c("Bacteroidota")

res <- calculate_phyla_ratio(ggdata_for_boxplot, num, denom) %>% 
       mutate(phenotype = factor(phenotype, levels = label_order),
              log2_ratio = log2(ratio))#, patient_id = paste(patient_id, "Cohort"))

res %>% group_by(phenotype) %>% summarise(mean_ratio = mean(ratio))

regressors <- c("bmi", "age", "gender")
ggdata <- res %>% left_join(patient_mdata %>% select(all_of(c("patient_id", regressors))), by = "patient_id")
perm_ancova_pairs(df = ggdata, X = "ratio", group =  "phenotype", covariates = regressors) %>% add_significance("p_value_perm_pair")

fb_ratio <- ggplot(res, aes(phenotype, log2_ratio, fill = phenotype, color = phenotype)) + 
             plot_box_and_jitter(palette) + 
             scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) gsub(" ", "\n" ,x)) + 
             ylim(min(res$log2_ratio)-0.1, 1.1*max(res$log2_ratio)) + # leave space for significance starts
             theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8)) + 
            labs(x = "Phenotype", y = "F/B Ratio [log2]")
plot(fb_ratio)

```

## 2.2 Alpha diversity

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=10, fig.align='center'}
alpha_div_metrics <- c("shannon",  "simpson")
ancova <- data.frame()
ggp_list <- list()

for (metric in alpha_div_metrics){
  ## Data preparation
  div <- vegan::diversity(taxa_df %>% tibble::column_to_rownames("sample_id"), index = metric)
  div_df <- data.frame(sample_id = names(div),metric = div) %>% 
            left_join(mdata, by = "sample_id") %>% 
            mutate(phenotype = factor(phenotype, levels = label_order))
  
  ancova_metric <- perm_ancova_pairs(df = div_df, X = "metric", group =  "phenotype", covariates = regressors)
  ancova <- rbind(ancova, ancova_metric %>% mutate(feature = metric))

  ## Visualization
  y_lab <- paste(stringr::str_to_title(metric), "diversity")
  
  ggp <- ggplot(div_df, aes(phenotype, metric, fill = phenotype, color = phenotype)) + 
    plot_box_and_jitter(palette = palette) +
    labs(x = "Phenotype", y = y_lab) + theme(legend.position = "none") + 
    scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) gsub(" ", "\n" ,x)) + 
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8)) + 
    ylim(min(div_df$metric)*0.95, max(div_df$metric)*1.1) # leave space for sig starts

  ggp_list[[metric]] <- ggp
}
ancova  %>% add_significance(pval_col = "p_value_perm_pair")
ggp_list[["shannon"]]
ggp_list[["simpson"]]

```


## 2.3 Beta diversity
```{r}
  genus_dist <- vegan::vegdist(taxa_df %>% tibble::column_to_rownames("sample_id"), method = "bray") %>% 
                as.matrix() %>% as.data.frame() %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id")
  tmp <- genus_dist %>% left_join(mdata, by = "sample_id")
  bd <- vegan::betadisper(d = as.dist(tmp %>% select(tmp$sample_id)), group = unname(tmp$phenotype), bias.adjust = TRUE)
  abd <- anova(bd)
  pbd <- vegan::permutest(bd, permutations = 999)
  print(abd)
  print(pbd)
```

## 2.5 Sensitivity analyses (supplementary)
Repeat the main analyses (F/B ratio, alpha and beta diversity, differential abundance) on two subsets:
1. Single batch - batch 22 samples only, without the mean samples (all controls were sequenced in batch 22, so batch can't be added as a covariate)
2. Age balanced - the largest subset of subjects in which FAP patients and controls don't differ in age

### 2.5.1 Single batch
```{r}
genus_ra_pre <- read.csv("processed_data/genus_ra_pre_batch_merge.csv")
colnames(genus_ra_pre) <- colnames(genus_ra_pre) %>% gsub(".*g__","",.)

batch_22_samples <- mdata_all %>% filter(batch == "Batch 22", sample_id %in% genus_ra_pre$sample_id) %>% pull(sample_id)
taxa_df_b22 <- genus_ra_pre %>% filter(sample_id %in% batch_22_samples) %>% tibble::column_to_rownames("sample_id") %>%
               remove_rare_features(prevalence_cutoff = 0.1, avg_abundance_cutoff = 0.001, rescale = T) %>%
               tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id")
```

Batch effect between the two samples of patients sequenced in both batches (permutations within patient)
```{r}
replicate_samples <- mdata_all %>% filter(sample_id %in% genus_ra_pre$sample_id) %>%
                     group_by(patient_id) %>% filter(n() > 1) %>% ungroup() %>% select(sample_id, patient_id, batch)
replicate_ra <- genus_ra_pre %>% filter(sample_id %in% replicate_samples$sample_id) %>%
                select(sample_id, all_of(colnames(taxa_df)[-1])) %>% tibble::column_to_rownames("sample_id")
replicate_ra <- replicate_ra / rowSums(replicate_ra)
replicate_mdata <- replicate_samples[match(rownames(replicate_ra), replicate_samples$sample_id), ]

replicate_dist <- vegan::vegdist(replicate_ra, method = "bray")
set.seed(111)
replicate_permanova <- vegan::adonis2(replicate_dist ~ patient_id + batch, data = replicate_mdata, by = "terms",
                                      permutations = permute::how(blocks = replicate_mdata$patient_id, nperm = 9999))
replicate_permanova
```

### 2.5.2 Age balanced
FAP patients (mainly classical FAP) are younger than the controls. Try all combinations of a minimal age for FAP patients and a maximal age for controls, and keep the combination with the largest number of subjects in which the groups don't differ in age (Wilcoxon p > 0.05 and standardized mean difference |SMD| < 0.25)
```{r}
smd <- function(x, is_fap) (mean(x[is_fap]) - mean(x[!is_fap])) / sd(x[is_fap])

cutoffs <- expand.grid(min_fap_age = sort(unique(mdata$age[mdata$is_fap])),
                       max_control_age = sort(unique(mdata$age[!mdata$is_fap])))
age_cutoffs <- data.frame()
for (i in 1:nrow(cutoffs)){
  d <- mdata %>% filter((is_fap & age >= cutoffs$min_fap_age[i]) | (!is_fap & age <= cutoffs$max_control_age[i]))
  if (sum(d$is_fap) < 5) next
  age_cutoffs <- rbind(age_cutoffs, data.frame(cutoffs[i, ], n = nrow(d), n_fap = sum(d$is_fap),
                                               smd_age = smd(d$age, d$is_fap),
                                               p_value = wilcox.test(age ~ is_fap, data = d, exact = FALSE)$p.value))
}
age_cutoff <- age_cutoffs %>% filter(p_value > 0.05, abs(smd_age) < 0.25) %>% arrange(desc(n), abs(smd_age)) %>% slice(1)
age_cutoff
```

```{r}
age_balanced <- mdata %>% filter((is_fap & age >= age_cutoff$min_fap_age) | (!is_fap & age <= age_cutoff$max_control_age))
age_balanced %>% group_by(phenotype) %>% summarise(n = n(), mean_age = mean(age), min_age = min(age), max_age = max(age))
write.csv(age_balanced %>% select(patient_id, sample_id, phenotype, age), "metadata/clean/age_balanced_subset.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

### 2.5.3 Analysis
Phylum relative abundance per patient, as in 2.1 but for a given set of samples
```{r}
get_patient_phyla <- function(samples){
  relab_phy[samples, ] %>% rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -sample_id, names_to = "taxon", values_to = "ra") %>%
    mutate(taxon = ifelse(taxon %in% non_rare_phyla, taxon, "Other")) %>%
    group_by(sample_id, taxon) %>% summarise(ra = sum(ra)) %>% ungroup() %>%
    inner_join(mdata_all, by = "sample_id") %>%
    group_by(patient_id, phenotype, phenotype_binary, taxon) %>% summarise(ra = mean(ra)) %>% ungroup()
}

sens_taxa <- list("Single batch" = taxa_df_b22,
                  "Age balanced" = taxa_df %>% filter(sample_id %in% age_balanced$sample_id))
sens_phyla_samples <- list("Single batch" = batch_22_samples,
                           "Age balanced" = mdata_all %>% filter(patient_id %in% age_balanced$patient_id,
                                                                sample_id %in% rownames(relab_phy)) %>% pull(sample_id))
```

```{r}
fb_sens <- data.frame()
alpha_sens <- data.frame()
beta_sens <- data.frame()
beta_plots <- list()
maaslin_sens <- data.frame()
ancova_sens <- data.frame()

for (src in names(sens_taxa)){
  taxa <- sens_taxa[[src]]
  md <- mdata_all %>% filter(sample_id %in% taxa$sample_id)

  # F/B ratio
  fb <- calculate_phyla_ratio(get_patient_phyla(sens_phyla_samples[[src]]), num, denom) %>%
        mutate(phenotype = factor(phenotype, levels = label_order), log2_ratio = log2(ratio)) %>%
        left_join(patient_mdata %>% select(all_of(c("patient_id", regressors))), by = "patient_id")
  set.seed(111)
  ancova_sens <- rbind(ancova_sens, perm_ancova_pairs(df = fb, X = "ratio", group = "phenotype", covariates = regressors) %>%
                                    mutate(source = src))
  fb_sens <- rbind(fb_sens, fb %>% mutate(source = src))

  # alpha diversity
  for (metric in alpha_div_metrics){
    div <- vegan::diversity(taxa %>% tibble::column_to_rownames("sample_id"), index = metric)
    div_df <- data.frame(sample_id = names(div), metric = div) %>%
              left_join(md, by = "sample_id") %>%
              mutate(phenotype = factor(phenotype, levels = label_order))
    set.seed(111)
    ancova_sens <- rbind(ancova_sens, perm_ancova_pairs(df = div_df, X = "metric", group = "phenotype", covariates = regressors) %>%
                                      mutate(feature = metric, source = src))
    alpha_sens <- rbind(alpha_sens, div_df %>% select(sample_id, phenotype, value = metric) %>% mutate(index = metric, source = src))
  }

  # beta diversity
  genus_dist <- vegan::vegdist(taxa %>% tibble::column_to_rownames("sample_id"), method = "bray") %>% as.matrix()
  md <- md[match(rownames(genus_dist), md$sample_id), ]
  set.seed(111)
  permanova <- vegan::adonis2(as.dist(genus_dist) ~ phenotype, data = md, permutations = 9999)
  bd <- vegan::betadisper(d = as.dist(genus_dist), group = md$phenotype, bias.adjust = TRUE)
  beta_sens <- rbind(beta_sens, data.frame(source = src, r2 = permanova$R2[1], p_permanova = permanova$`Pr(>F)`[1],
                                           p_dispersion = anova(bd)$`Pr(>F)`[1]))
  beta_plots[[src]] <- plot_colored_pcoa_discrete(genus_dist %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column("sample_id"),
                                                  md %>% mutate(phenotype = factor(phenotype, levels = label_order)),
                                                  "sample_id", "phenotype", "Bray-Curtis", pcoa_fill = palette, level = 0.9)$p

  # differential abundance
  da <- get_differential_abundance(taxa, md, metadata_cols_to_analyze = c("phenotype_binary"), metadata_cols_fix_effects = regressors)
  maaslin_sens <- rbind(maaslin_sens, da$all_results %>% filter(!metadata %in% regressors) %>% mutate(source = src))
}

ancova_sens %>% select(source, feature, contrast, effect_size, hedges_g, p_value_perm_pair)
beta_sens
```

```{r}
ggdata <- maaslin_sens %>%
           mutate(is_significant = FDR < 0.05,
           is_coef = abs(coef) > 1,
           is_highlight = is_significant & is_coef,
           label = ifelse(is_highlight, feature, ""),
           color = ifelse(is_highlight & coef < 1, labels[[1]], labels[[2]]),
           color = ifelse(!is_highlight,"Non-Significant", color),
           source = factor(source, levels = names(sens_taxa)))

# compare to the genera found in the full data
ggdata %>% left_join(maaslin_features %>% select(feature, original = `maaslin taxonomy`), by = "feature") %>%
           count(source, original, color)
```

### 2.5.4 Supplementary panels
Panel sizes are set to fit a 7.5 x 7.5 inch slide (top row: F/B ratio, Shannon, Simpson; bottom row: beta diversity of the two subsets one above the other, volcano)
```{r, fig.width=2.5, fig.height=2.5}
fb_sens <- fb_sens %>% mutate(source = factor(source, levels = names(sens_taxa)))
fb_ratio_sens <- ggplot(fb_sens, aes(phenotype, log2_ratio, fill = phenotype, color = phenotype)) +
                 plot_box_and_jitter(palette, font_size = 10, point_size = 1) +
                 facet_wrap(~source) +
                 theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7, angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
                 labs(x = "Phenotype", y = "F/B Ratio [log2]")
fb_ratio_sens
ggsave("figures/f1/supp_sens_fb_ratio.svg", fb_ratio_sens, width = 2.5, height = 2.5)
```

```{r, fig.width=2.5, fig.height=2.5}
alpha_sens <- alpha_sens %>% mutate(source = factor(source, levels = names(sens_taxa)))
for (metric in alpha_div_metrics){
  ggp <- ggplot(alpha_sens %>% filter(index == metric), aes(phenotype, value, fill = phenotype, color = phenotype)) +
         plot_box_and_jitter(palette, font_size = 10, point_size = 1) +
         facet_wrap(~source) +
         theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7, angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
         labs(x = "Phenotype", y = paste(stringr::str_to_title(metric), "diversity"))
  plot(ggp)
  ggsave(paste0("figures/f1/supp_sens_alpha_div_", metric, ".svg"), ggp, width = 2.5, height = 2.5)
}
```

```{r, fig.width=3.75, fig.height=2.5}
for (src in names(beta_plots)){
  ggp <- beta_plots[[src]] +
         labs(fill = "", title = src) +
         theme(text = element_text(size = 10), legend.position = "none")
  plot(ggp)
  ggsave(paste0("figures/f1/supp_sens_beta_div_", gsub(" ", "_", tolower(src)), ".svg"), ggp, width = 3.75, height = 2.5)
}
```

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=3.75}
volcano_sens <- plot_volcano(ggdata, n_label_overlaps = 7, label_size = 2.5, fdr_min = 0.05, point_size = 1.5) +
                facet_wrap(~source, ncol = 2) +
                scale_color_manual(values = palette) +
                guides(color = guide_legend(title = NULL)) +
                theme_bw(base_size = 10) + theme(legend.position = "none")
volcano_sens
```
